message: １０万兆億不可思議

name: Arden
message: 「Woooaaah! I lost! I was defeated fair and square by a cowardly opponent!」

name: Arden
message: 「Sorry, Pasta-chan! I'm gonna go train deep in the mountains for about half a year, so forgive meee! Waaaaaaaah!」

name: Misa
message: 「He's running away crying...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How strange. Even though we won, it somehow feels like we did something wrong.」

name: Ria
message: 「You almost start to feel sorry for him, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Even so, if we hadn't won, we'd be in trouble」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What was his deal anyway?」

name: Misa
message: 「Who knows?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hahaha! Justice always prevails!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Scary」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, w-what?」
I instinctively grabbed Nanaka by both shoulders.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Don't push yourself, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「E-eh, w-wait, that's」

name: Synn
message: 「Just now, you said sca--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-if you stare at me like that, I'm gonna think you're falling for me! Ahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「D-don't joke around. I'm worried about」
Just now, she said it was scary

name: Nanaka
message: 「Somehow, once that guy left, I started feeling better! I'm totally fine now! Right?」
I take my hands off her shoulders. The sensation of a faint trembling lingers.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, for her guardian angel not to answer...」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister. What could this mean?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think this is a first. I'll try asking Onee-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nice to meet you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't need to worry so much, I'm fine. It was just a fluke. Seriously, just a fluke」

name: Synn
message: 「But you weren't feeling well the other day either!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, you're worried about me......」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Of course I am! How could I not be worried!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-We're comrades, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right...... You're like that with everyone, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah」
Is that really true?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer, did you eat something bad?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't tell me some foreign-grown buckwheat got mixed into your soba flour?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way! Our soba is 100% pure domestically grown organic!」
Nanaka......

name: Synn
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Drawing out the Demon Lord's power has gotten a whole lot smoother」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I think so too」

name: Paqy
message: 「And it's lasting over ten minutes now. It's finally at a level you can actually use in a real fight」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I'm finally starting to get the hang of how to use it」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, it's a far cry from its true power」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You could probably beat Pasta or Eauderourke one-on-one like this, though」

name: Synn
message: 「What about Arden?」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-Well, you'd barely be evenly matched」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's weird. By this point, you oughta be a little stronger than this, though......」

name: Synn
message: 「Then that's plenty!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, that ain't like you, Master Synn. What's got you in such a rush?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I can fight on equal footing or better against a Demon General, there's no problem, right?」
The Demon Lord. King of the Demons.
From Nanaka's perspective, the boss of everything she fears.
Even so, I want power.

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, well. All the remaining Demon Generals are--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Having motivation as the Demon Lord is a good thing, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Starting tonight, I'm patrolling the academy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't push yourself when you're already wiped out from practice.」

name: Synn
message: 「But a Demon General might show up even tonight!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You think you can fight and win when you're not in top shape?」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's start tomorrow. The great me is tired too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「No need to rush seeking power.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not rushing!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Just what I'd expect from the Demon Lord. Fending off the Demons all on your own to protect your academy harem plan--you're a man among men!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there is no such plan. I just want to protect my sparkling academy life.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure it's not one specific person you wanna protect?」
Nanaka's face flashed in my mind.

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's not!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmm. Is that right. Well, that's the kinda guy you are, Master Synn.」

name: Paqy
message: 「At least up until now.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right. Because I'm the Student Council President of Ryuusei Academy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you don't get to sleep soon, Soba's gonna start suspecting things she shouldn't.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」
